name: RCP_GLOBAL_DOCTRINE_V2
purpose: Upgrade Repo Control Protocol from execution control to controlled discovery and reverse engineering.

core_shift.principle: Code is instrumentation inside a research engine; every task must explain where edge was created, preserved, or destroyed.

measurement_requirements.interpretation: Profitability is insufficient. Every serious run must report how much available movement was actually extracted.

layer_accountability.rule: No run is complete unless it labels where the edge died.
layer_accountability.failure_question: Was the loss caused by entry logic, implementation, simulator, AEE interaction, or filtering?

requirements: test 3-5 structurally different forms per concept
test 2-3 coarse presets per form before local tuning
compare against champion and baseline on every run
promote only after comparative ranking and ablation

hard_rules: If all forms of a concept fail, block threshold tuning and escalate to implementation, simulation, or AEE audit.
If breakout survives while pullback or reclaim consistently fail, assume simulation bias until disproven.
If entry-only performance materially exceeds realized performance, assume AEE mismatch until disproven.
If filtered performance is weaker than raw firehose performance, assume filters are destructive until disproven.
Do not segment by regime before aggregate extraction and attribution are understood.
Reject hard-mode tasks that are not falsifiable with explicit fail conditions and effect-size floors.
Reject hard-mode tasks when evaluation metrics violate layer-metric lock.
Reject parallel hard-mode tests unless causality isolation is explicit.
Auto-fail when primary edge protection threshold is breached.
Auto-fail when primary-edge regression is masked by secondary improvements.

adjudication_logic.PROMOTE: Evidence supports the task hypothesis and required artifacts exist.
adjudication_logic.REJECT: Evidence disproves the task hypothesis or scope was violated.
adjudication_logic.NO_OP: Task ran but produced no materially new information.
adjudication_logic.INCOMPLETE: Artifacts or evidence are missing; repeat in same scope.
adjudication_logic.BLOCKED: An upstream layer prevents valid interpretation.
